issue.title: agents_auto_approve_workflow_child_alignment PNG golden drifts: deck spread footer shows 'main 1' instead of 'main 0' in some full visual runs
issue.description: Found by the sase-17x.13.10 land agent. In 1 of 3 full just test-visual runs on master 7cb835953 plus a Command Line-only diff (run .pytest_cache/sase-visual/runs/ac3da3d511a2424f9b63693d0155ea71 in the sase_41 workspace; 1040 passed), agents_auto_approve_workflow_child_alignment_120x40 drifted. The only changed pixels are the deck spread footer count: the golden reads 'spread main 0 · files 0 · tools 0', the capture 'spread main 1 · files 0 · tools 0'. The two earlier full runs the same evening (9449fcad…, 12dae007…) did not drift. The main-card count likely depends on whether an async main-card load lands before capture. Root cause not investigated; no Command Line code renders in this test.

task_type_fields.evidence: 1 drift in 3 full runs on an unchanged tree; diff bbox (1181,900)-(1192,916) is only the 'main N' digit.
